stem: Which of the following is the set notation for the interval ${=lb}{=a}, {=b}{=rb}$?
solution: The interval ${=lb}{=a}, {=b}{=rb}$ runs from ${=a}$ to ${=b}$, so the inequality has ${=a}$ on the left, $x$ in the middle and ${=b}$ on the right.
At ${=a}$ the bracket is {=lbn}, so ${=a}$ {=lin} the set and the sign is ${=ls}$.
At ${=b}$ the bracket is {=hbn}, so ${=b}$ {=hin} the set and the sign is ${=hs}$.
notes: Standard: interval notation to set notation, both ends finite, all four bracket patterns (ex6-1-1b shape). mcq is natural here because each distractor is one specific bracket/sign mix-up: both signs flipped, only the left sign flipped, only the right sign flipped, so the four options are always distinct. The stem carries {=...} holes, so distinct_by_choices is not set. Computed strings use Unicode <= and < (no backslash in expression strings).
